metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract:
--FILE--A Chinese netizen browses the website of automotive parts company Takata in Ji'nan city, east China's Shandong province, 26 June 2017.

Chinese regulators announced on Friday that Tesla will recall 14,123 imported Model S cars in the country due to life-risking issues in its airbags. According to the report of the United States Department of Transportation, the airbags are initiated by a propellant that might damage the bags causing serious injuries or death. The recall of the model is part of a global crackdown of cars equipped with Takata front passenger airbags. The department noted that around 37 million vehicles that include known brands like Toyota and Ford.

metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract:
On Monday 25 May 2026, the day after the body of a 12-year-old boy who had been strangled (the boy was found with a wet towel tightly wrapped around his neck) was discovered on the banks of the Vilaine in Rennes (France), detectives from the Judicial Police, assisted by a team of divers who searched the river, were looking for clues to shed light on the circumstances of this tragedy.
Lundi 25 mai 2026, au lendemain de la decouverte du corps d un enfant de 12 ans tue par etranglement (le garcon a ete retrouve avec une serviette mouillee fortement serree autour du cou) sur les bords de la Vilaine a Rennes (France), les enqueteurs de la Police Judiciaire epaules par une equipe de plongeurs qui ont sonde la riviere etaient a la recherche d indices afin d eclaircir les circonstances de ce drame. (Photo by Estelle Ruiz / Hans Lucas via AFP)
